_comment: Regional directions in the 2-pass smoothed flux-control space of the 1° 90-day frozen upwind3 window (1161433): the smoothed gradient Sᵀ g restricted to convecting and stable columns of the North Atlantic (forward state of health_ecco4_onedegree_nz20_90day_upwind3) and to the Labrador Sea and the eastern subpolar gyre, for finite-difference error bars of the frozen-CATKE adjoint (LOGBOOK finding 30).
